filo_ambulance.description:
- Add a mouse gizmo to the hospital creator for peds, beds and vehicle spawns: drag the arrows to move, the ring to turn, click to drop the point, hold right mouse to look around. Arrow keys and Page Up / Down nudge, scroll turns, Shift gives fine steps, G brings it to you
- Change **Add bed** to keep placing beds and their get-up points until you press Enter. Each bed is still its own entry, and Backspace takes back the last point
- Change adding AI medic path points and stashes to keep placing until Enter

filo_bolt.description: - Fix player collision and movement during camera use

filo_chat.description:
- Rework the UI in the Filo liquid chrome look: graphite surfaces, silver chrome buttons and highlights, upright sentence-case text, no glows, gradients or scanlines
- Change the default `accent` and `background` to the liquid chrome colours (`#D9DBE0` / `#141415`). Set your own colours in the branding config to keep your look

filo_consumables.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_discordgate.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_drugscreator.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_fastfood.description:
- Add **Move with gizmo** to every spawn, path, counter and line point
- Change **Record points** to **Place points**: move a see-through copy of yourself with a mouse gizmo and press E to drop each point, Enter when done
- Change seat placement to the mouse gizmo while you sit in the seat: drag the arrows to move, the ring to turn, click to drop it, hold right mouse to look around

filo_jack.description: - Remove the `community_bridge` dependency: a built-in bridge now detects Qbox, QBCore or ESX. You can remove `community_bridge` from your server if nothing else uses it

filo_muffler.description: - Refactor vehicle state management and update version checker

filo_police.description:
- Add a mouse gizmo to the police and jail creators for peds and vehicle spawns: drag the arrows to move, the ring to turn, click to drop the point, hold right mouse to look around. Arrow keys and Page Up / Down nudge, scroll turns, Shift gives fine steps, G brings it to you
- Change **Add** in the jail creator to keep placing cells, spawns and job spots until you press Enter. Each point is still its own entry, and Backspace takes back the last one

filo_rewards.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_slashtire.description:
- Add qb-target support
- Add translatable labels under `locales/`
- Change slashing to be checked by the server (distance and held weapon)
- Fix only the last slashed tire syncing to players who join later or drive up to the vehicle
- Fix players getting stuck in place while turning towards the tire
- Fix players staying marked as busy if the slash was interrupted

filo_stealwheels.description: - Remove the `community_bridge` dependency: a built-in bridge now detects Qbox, QBCore or ESX, `ox_inventory` and `ox_target` or `qb-target`. You can remove `community_bridge` from your server if nothing else uses it

filo_ui.description: - Change screen titles to uppercase in Barlow Semi Condensed Bold (upright), for example `FOB PROGRAMMER` and `LAST STAND`. Buttons, tabs and labels stay in sentence case

filo_vehiclekeys.description:
- Add a built-in framework, inventory and target bridge for Qbox, QBCore and ESX, detected automatically
- Change sleepless_prompts, tr_core and tr_minigames to separate downloads: use the Filo Scripts forks at https://github.com/filo-studios/sleepless_prompts, https://github.com/filo-studios/tr_core and https://github.com/filo-studios/tr_minigames instead of the copies that came with the download
- Fix the in-vehicle prompts taking over the ignition, engine, hotwire and search keybinds and leaving them dead
- Fix vehicle state errors when a vehicle handle was missing or invalid
- Remove the `community_bridge` dependency. You can remove it from your server if nothing else uses it
